Consistency before complexity.

DATA QUALITY

Start with the measurements.

The source had no missing values, but that did not make every measurement plausible. Fixed rules removed extreme height, weight, blood-pressure and BMI values before modelling.

Cleaning rules are included in the analysis notebook and preparation script.

04 / WHAT THE SCORES DON'T SAY

Research is also knowing where to stop.

The useful part
was the questioning.

01

More features didn't mean better results.

BMI and pulse pressure sounded useful. The ablation experiments found no material improvement from adding them. Intuition needed to be tested.

02

A complex model can still overfit.

The unrestricted Decision Tree performed weakest in the primary comparison. Tuning and validation mattered more than complexity alone.

03

One dataset is not the real world.

No external validation or probability-calibration study was completed. Small score differences were not shown to be statistically significant. This is an academic classification study, not a clinical diagnostic tool.
